Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: one exercise illustration in a knee rehabilitation guide. Art direction: polished realistic medical illustration, an adult man in his thirties with short brown hair, a plain heather-gray T-shirt, black exercise shorts and white trainers. Plain pure-white background, soft neutral studio lighting, subtle grounding shadow, blue exercise mat only for floor exercises. Single clearly readable pose. Landscape 1536x1024 composition; entire person, hands, both feet and all required equipment fully inside the frame with generous margins. Consistent human proportions and natural anatomy, professional physiotherapy handout quality. No titles, labels, letters, numbers, arrows, panels, frames, watermarks, extra figures, line-drawing stick people, or cut-off equipment. Depict only the stated movement.
Primary request: Front three-quarter view of seated resistance-band ankle eversion on a simple stable chair. Both knees remain still over planted heels. A blue loop exercise band wraps around the forefeet of both shoes and its ends are held loosely in his hands. His right forefoot turns gently up and OUTWARD against band tension while its heel stays in place; the left foot remains still and provides the counter-resistance. Show the complete seated man, chair, both feet and the band, with the band and foot position large enough to read clearly.
assets.framing_edit_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied exercise illustration. Change ONLY the framing: zoom out slightly and expand the plain white canvas so the complete subject and equipment have visible white margin on every side, especially at the TOP. For the seated ankle exercise show the whole crown of the man's head with at least 5% white margin above his hair. For the Nordic curl show the complete upper ends of both rack uprights and the whole overhead crossbar, with at least 5% white margin above the highest rack point. Keep the exact existing exercise pose, human identity, clothing, limb positions, equipment geometry, resistance-band routing, lighting, white background and illustration style. Keep the same landscape image shape. Do not crop the head, feet, rack or mat. No added labels, text, panels or decorations.
